text:
ashley: Consolidating follow-ups from the token-validation postmortem. Root causes: vendor signing key expired, permission-canary not turned on in ap-southeast, and audit events missing user_id for two token endpoints. Posting owners + short ETAs. Please ack. :clipboard:

ryan: i'll own key-rotation automation + CI dry-run. plan: GH Actions workflow + verification job that prints planned swap. ETA: 2026-04-01 for dry-run logs. need security sign-off on IAM tweak.

celeste: taking audit events (emit user_id + request_id) and a backfill job for the last 7 days. est: 1 sprint, can compress if we freeze low-priority PRs. will open draft PR and a consumer migration note.

ryan: proposing canary gate and pre-deploy smoke tests. datadog query i'm going to push (tweak if needed):

```
logs("service:auth AND http.path:/token/* AND !user_id").rollup("count").last("10m") > 5
```

infra-bot: Auto-created tracker card: https://redwood/tracker/INC-2139. Card fields: owner, eta, status, linked PRs.

sec-bot: Reminder: owners must ack within 24h or actions escalate. Please attach IAM policy diff for review.

ops: on-prem maintenance window requested: 2026-04-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. managed customers to be notified 2026-04-06. air-gapped installs need manual scheduling.

celeste: will emit both old and new event keys during a 14-day compatibility window and add a compatibility flag. backfill job will run after schema emission.

ryan: rotation plan = monthly scheduled rotate with staged swap (previous key valid 48h). script supports `--staged` and `--rollback`. example: `./scripts/rotate-keys --staged --verify`. i'll add runbook steps.

ashley: checklist copied to tracker: - [ ] GH workflow + CI dry-run (ryan) - [ ] IAM policy diff + sec approval (ryan + security) - [ ] Emit user_id + request_id + backfill (celeste) - [ ] Permission canary + predeploy tests (ryan) - [ ] Playbook + runbook updates (infra) - [ ] Customer notice for on-prem (ops)

ryan: acked. posting dry-run logs to the card when done.

celeste: acked. draft PR link will be posted in tracker.

ops: acked. scheduling notice for managed customers.

ashley: thanks all. quick sync Fri 09:00 to surface blockers. leave short updates here if you make progress. :calendar:
